result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban intersection featuring a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the crossing is uncontrolled and sightlines are partially obscured by vehicles parked close to the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked near the corner on the right side of the image may block the line of sight between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides and a curb ramp with tactile paving at the corner. While the narrow street geometry likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, the environment lacks marked crosswalks and suffers from sightline obstructions due to cars parked near the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk with a modern curb ramp and tactile paving in a residential area. However, the crossing is uncontrolled and lacks physical traffic calming measures or street trees to provide a buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any visible stop signs, signals, or warning signs to regulate vehicle traffic at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The long, straight, and relatively wide roadway without physical obstructions may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase the prominence of the crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.
